name: Shorts from a long video
about: You have a long video. The agent picks the moments that stand alone, you choose which to make, it cuts each as a 9:16 Short, you review them, and you export.

stages.title: Pick moments
stages.focus: Find the moments of the long video that work alone as Shorts (a hook in the first two seconds, one idea, a payoff, 20 to 60 s). The source is video/out/rough.mp4 when there is one (its words are video/out/rough-words.json: use them, never transcribe again; a project made from an edit has both linked in), else video/out/final.mp4, else the footage (transcribe it once if no word file exists). Times in the picks are seconds on that source. Write studio/shorts/picks.json: { "picks": [ { "id": "s1", "src": "rough, a source key of the edit list, or a file relative to video/", "from": seconds, "to": seconds, "title": "...", "hook": "the first line", "why": "..." } ] }, five to ten picks, best first.

stages.title: Choose
stages.focus: The user chooses which picks to make (the Shorts tab marks them "chosen": true in studio/shorts/picks.json) and approves.

stages.title: Cut each
stages.focus: Cut every chosen pick in studio/shorts/picks.json as its own 9:16 Short, each in its own workshop shorts/<pick id>/video/ (footage/, out/; run the engine with --video shorts/<pick id>/video): the edit list, the rough, captions in the Shorts style and the final (out/final.mp4). Put the source in the Short's footage/ as a hard link (never a copy of a big file); when video/out/rough-words.json is there, take each Short's words from it instead of transcribing again. Heavy renders run in the background, one Short after the other. Anything the user should check in a Short goes in shorts/<pick id>/video/out/review-items.json (times on that Short). A Short sent back with notes: cut only the Shorts the notes name.

stages.title: Review
stages.focus: The user watches every Short and approves, or sends them back with notes (name the Short).

stages.title: Export
stages.focus: Each Short's MP4 and SRT from the Export tab.
